items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: We all hung around Tom and Hanksons enough.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, uh, there's a lot of them are really nice. And they're nicely written up, and, uh, they just go out of a dream, or, uh, some fellow writes a book out in these states down in the 10-line district from the beginning to the end. You know what? And an ordinary person reading the book, they're going to say, my Jesus Christ, the brown band must have come right to my whole house. And we never did play around there. And our music wouldn't have been, as I told you before, it wouldn't have been acceptable for…
We all hung around Tom and Hanksons enough.
My God, I used to go down there. I guess that's before your days, isn't it? Yeah, yeah. Let's see. What time did they break up that dreadlight district?
